# netbox_rack_role (Resource)

A NetBox rack role (dcim.rackrole).

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/rackrole/):

> Each rack can optionally be assigned a user-defined functional role. For example, you might designate a rack for compute or storage resources, or to house colocated customer devices.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_rack_role" "test" {
  name        = "test-rack-role"
  slug        = "test-rack-role"
  color_hex   = "112233"
  description = "test-description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)

### Optional

- `color_hex` (String) RGB color in hex (e.g. ff0000). Defaults to 9e9e9e.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values by field name. Every value is a string; NetBox coerces numbers and booleans. A key removed from the map is cleared in NetBox (set {} to clear all).
- `description` (String)
- `owner_id` (Number) Id of the owner the object is assigned to.
- `slug` (String) URL-friendly unique shorthand; derived from name when not set.
- `tags` (Set of String) Slugs of the tags assigned to the object (the provider's default_tags are added on top, see tags_all).

### Read-Only

- `created` (String)
- `id` (Number) NetBox id.
- `last_updated` (String)
- `rack_count` (Number) Number of racks with the rack role.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) Slugs of all tags on the object, including the provider's default_tags.
- `url` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netbox_rack_role.test
  id = "123"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netbox_rack_role.test 123
```
